# C152 MF07 学習音声を拡充 / 2026-11-12
# この末尾の専用セルだけを実行する。
from google.colab import files
expanded_upload=files.upload()
# 入力を照合し、固定したIrodori環境を準備
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,io,json,subprocess,sys,zipfile
blob=expanded_upload['irodori-mf07-expanded-input-20261112-v1.zip']
assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()=='e588a667a2491b598385d292887870ae9cd900c41893966dd735ec9fff1a84a4'
exp_root=Path('/content/sumi_mf07_expanded_20261112');exp_root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
exp_input=exp_root/'input';exp_input.mkdir()
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as z:
    assert all((exp_input/n).resolve().is_relative_to(exp_input.resolve()) for n in z.namelist())
    z.extractall(exp_input)
for name,expected in json.loads((exp_input/'SHA256.json').read_text()).items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((exp_input/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,name
print('EXPANDED_INPUT_VERIFIED',len(blob))
exp_setup_log=exp_root/'setup.log'
with exp_setup_log.open('x') as log:
    exp_setup=subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','900s',sys.executable,'-u',str(exp_input/'pilot.py'),'setup','--work',str(exp_root/'work'),'--profile','mf07'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('EXPANDED_SETUP_STARTED',exp_setup.pid)
# 環境準備の状態
print('SETUP_RETURN_CODE',exp_setup.poll())
print(exp_setup_log.read_text()[-2000:])
# 追加80文の教師生成と、同じモデルでの振幅補正学習
assert exp_setup.poll()==0
exp_python=exp_root/'work/Irodori-TTS/.venv/bin/python'
subprocess.run([str(exp_python),'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(exp_input),'-p','test_*.py','-v'],check=True,timeout=60)
subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'],check=True)
exp_driver_log=exp_root/'driver.log'
with exp_driver_log.open('x') as log:
    exp_process=subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','960s',str(exp_python),'-u',str(exp_input/'expand_magnitude.py'),str(exp_root)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('EXPANDED_RUN_STARTED',exp_process.pid)
# 教師生成・学習の状態
print('RUN_RETURN_CODE',exp_process.poll())
print('GENERATED',len(list((exp_root/'teacher').glob('*/result.json'))))
for name in ['driver.log','generation.log','training.log']:
    p=exp_root/name
    if p.exists():print(name,p.read_text()[-1800:])
# 生成物と入力・ログを保存。Macへの退避後にGPU停止。
assert exp_setup.poll() is not None
if 'exp_process' in globals():assert exp_process.poll() is not None
exp_zip=Path('/content/sumi_mf07_expanded_results_20261112.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(exp_zip,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for label in ['input','teacher','data','output']:
        root=exp_root/label
        if root.exists():
            for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
                if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts:z.write(p,str(p.relative_to(exp_root)))
    for p in exp_root.glob('*.log'):z.write(p,p.name)
    if (exp_root/'work/cache.json').exists():z.write(exp_root/'work/cache.json','cache.json')
print('RESULT_ZIP',exp_zip.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(exp_zip.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
files.download(str(exp_zip))
